note: inventoryMethodsImplemented counts contracts/sdk-endpoints.json entries backed by hand-written resource methods; inventoryMethodsUnimplemented counts entries with no method. Snapshot conformance is reported separately under openapiConformance.
openapiNote: contracts/openapi/api.openapi.json is the pinned upstream snapshot (sha256 in contracts/openapi/manifest.json) and covers a subset of the API with a different path vocabulary, so the gaps above are expected. It is authoritative and not edited here; contracts/coverage-floor.json ratchets the matched baseline.
